errors.text: The predicted fracture-morphology direction is reversed: the target associates HPHT treatment with distributed or isolated microcracking rather than the elongated interfacial cracks of the brittle baseline.

The cited evidence does not directly support the central HPHT claim, its exact 6 GPa/1473 K/2 h conditions, coherent-interface transformation, GND convergence, or mechanical-property enhancement in Al0.7CoCrFeNi.
